claims: All Target stores in the United States will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, to allow employees to observe the holiday.
Target closes for only a few major holidays, including Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.
Customers can still shop online at Target.com or through the Target app.
Target stores' normal operating hours will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Walmart will remain open on April 5, 2026.
CVS will remain open on April 5, 2026.
